Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

New Year's Concert 2025

February 15, 2025 · St. Thekla Ochsenfurt

On February 15, 2025, the New Year's Concert "From Baroque to Harry Potter" took place at St. Thekla. Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt (director: Dr. Astrid Eitschberger), the Ukrainian vocal ensemble FAINO (director: Viktoriia Hromova), and preschool children from the St. Thekla kindergarten (director: Petra Striffler) created a varied program. The collected donations benefited the St. Thekla kindergarten, which used them to support its activities.
